title: Uncertainty Packet v1
description: Surfaces stalled/uncertain work to operators and downstream agents. Prevents agents from claiming 'fixed' when work is uncertain. Inspired by AI Co-Mathematician uncertainty lifecycle (arXiv:2605.06651).

level.description: low = minor gap, medium = needs attention, high = blocked or unverified runtime, critical = operator must act

type.description: One or more uncertainty categories applicable to this item

why.description: Human-readable explanation of what is uncertain and why

evidence_needed.description: Specific evidence that would resolve or reduce this uncertainty

operator_decision_needed.description: True if this uncertainty cannot be resolved without human/operator input

next_safe_check.description: What to check or verify next to reduce uncertainty. Empty string if unknown.

detected_at.description: When this uncertainty was first detected

detected_by.description: Agent or lane that detected this uncertainty
